name: Force arrows
paragraph: Add up to four arrows until the net force matches the target. Ten setups. Not for sale yet.

name: Ontario path
paragraph: Six original pictures, each one linked to a free chapter. The check marks stay in this browser.

name: Seesaw
paragraph: A weight is already on the left. Pick a weight and a distance on the right until the torques match.

name: Motion graphs
paragraph: The line is position against time. Mark each piece forward, still, or back.

name: Shear and moment
paragraph: Slide a load on a beam, then read the peak moment off the shear diagram. Four beams.

name: One truss joint
paragraph: One joint, a 3-4-5 member, a horizontal member, and a load straight down. Pick the two tensions.

name: Nodes on a string
paragraph: Both ends stay fixed. Set the length and the frequency until the node count matches.

name: Enlightened
paragraph: Five moves of an argument, two passes, and a place to build one yourself. The page checks each drill. Not for sale yet.

name: Meditations, Book 2
paragraph: Casaubon's 1634 translation, fifteen sections. Sort one clause from each: in my power, or not.

name: Mark
paragraph: The Gospel of Mark, all sixteen chapters, in the World English Bible. A margin note stays in this browser. Not for sale yet.

name: The Opening and the Unity
paragraph: Pickthall's 1930 English for two chapters, beside the Tanzil Arabic. Both texts are unchanged. Not for sale yet.

name: First-year path
paragraph: Six doors into the free Rebus philosophy series. Five original questions. Philosophy of religion stays a link. Not for sale yet.

name: Colour Match
paragraph: Answer five quick questions, upload one selfie, and get your season, undertone, the colours that suit you and the ones to skip. Then let the extension grey out the wrong shades while you shop.
price: The palette is free. The extension is $19 once, or $4 a month.

name: Financial calculators
paragraph: 11 free calculators for Canadian mortgages, debt payoff, investing and marketing ROI. Real Canadian math: semi-annual compounding, the stress test, and Toronto land transfer tax. No sign-up.

name: Teleprompter
paragraph: Film with the front camera while the script scrolls on the lens. Turn the phone and the words follow the camera. Scripts stay on the phone. The take saves to the phone or downloads to the laptop.

name: Cell and Molecule Explorer
paragraph: Zoom from a drop of pond water to a single atom, then explore microorganisms, cells, molecules and the elements.

name: Anatomy Sandbox
paragraph: Turn it, pose it, make it walk. Tap any muscle to see the exercises that work it.
